data.description:
PENDING OPERATOR APPROVAL of the proposed move text (see below) before implementing.

Existing Pass-4 coach moves (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/coach_moves.py MOVE_REGISTRY) are ADJACENT to T15 but none captures its specific remedy:
- move 1 "spike" — "de-risk {subject} before committing the plan" (exploratory, not tied to the slow delivery loop or a manual-against-real probe)
- move 4 "riskiest-assumption test" — "test the riskiest assumption first" (generic assumption, not the runtime mechanism / loop-cost framing)
- move 7 "thin vertical slice" — decomposition-flavored; T15 is explicitly NOT about decomposition

The T15 gap: when the finder surfaces a T15 finding, the productive coaching nudge is "move the proof OUT of the slow loop into the fastest available out-of-loop experiment (a local run or a manual probe against the real target) before codifying it." No current move says that.

## Proposed addition (for approval)
Add a new move to MOVE_REGISTRY scoped to T15 via applies_when (mirrors move 10 -> [G5,A1,T2] and move 13 -> [G7]):

  "15": {
      "name": "out-of-loop proof",
      "template": "Prove {subject} with the fastest out-of-loop experiment — a local run or a manual probe against the real target — before committing it to the slow delivery loop.",
      "applies_when": ["T15"],
  }

## Acceptance criteria
- Operator approves (or amends) the move name/template above; decision recorded as a comment on this ticket.
- If approved: move 15 added to MOVE_REGISTRY with applies_when ["T15"]; validate_move_registry passes; a T15 finding renders the move-15 nudge deterministically.
- If rejected: this ticket is closed with the rationale recorded and no code change.
data.title: Add proposed coach move 'out-of-loop proof' (applies_when T15) — PENDING approval
